title: Sales documents
summary: Invoices, credit notes and consignment-out documents.

steps.text: The sidebar groups sales documents into {inv}, {cn} and {co}. Each opens the same document list filtered to that type.

You can also ask the assistant to create, send, finalize or void an invoice or credit note, or record a payment against it. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm. A card that sends a document outside Celerp says so.
